title: Independent Static-Stylized QA — Continuous Small Life Batch 35

source_of_truth.source_binding: Expected source IDs and GLB SHA pins matched the exact candidate and delivered exports.

standard.judgment: PASS applies to independent visual, artifact-integrity, source/export, profile-compatibility, Khronos, and software-WebGL review of these four exact assets.
standard.formal_acceptance_boundary: This report does not promote candidate stage statuses, does not change approved_for_brief=false, and does not claim a hardware-GPU/device-performance pass.

method.animation_skills_under_.agents: Read; not applicable to these static, non-animated assets.
method.fixed_views: Opened source contact sheets for all four assets; checked exact eight source frame paths, dimensions and SHA-256 from each pinned view manifest.
method.runtime: Independently reloaded the exact GLB files with repository viewer and Chromium; regenerated all 48 software-WebGL captures. Every one was byte-identical to the corresponding frozen capture.
method.source_export: Blender 4.3.2 opened each delivered Blend read-only with autoexec disabled, compared evaluated export geometry and bounds to the exact GLB. Smooth-face review warnings were visually inspected in source/clay/runtime images and treated as intentional shading, not export errors.
method.rebuild: Eight real Blender queue jobs (two per asset) ran in scratch storage. All regenerated GLB files were byte-for-byte identical to the frozen GLBs.
method.glb_validation: Independent Khronos validator rerun on temporary copies; all four had zero errors and zero warnings.
method.reviewer_context: Fresh independent delegated QA context; the runtime model variant was not exposed to the reviewer and is not asserted.

batch_verdict.actual_physical_gpu_device_performance: UNKNOWN; not tested in the cloud software-renderer run
batch_verdict.representative_scene_scope: Six instances were captured and draw-call/triangle counts recorded; no timing, thermal, or physical-device claim.

notes: 只评价基础形态与原创教学美术，不评价精确板片、软组织或取食机制。
